name: Data.exists_restrict_bordered
summary: r is the adjoint (on the finite-dimensional space of level chosenLevel) of the period functional for the trivial twist; for general ϑ the period of a level-ϑ form equals that of its average over chosenLevel, because the twisted and untwisted periods differ by translations that fix φ.

steps.claim: The kernel pair of the grid at (0, 0) is a conjugate pair (`isConjKernelPair_gridKernel`; he).
steps.lean: have he := @isConjKernelPair_gridKernel _ D false 0 0 (by simp) false

steps.claim: Forms of the type are a smooth representation (each has an open level), and the forms of level chosenLevel form a finite-dimensional space (`Space.finite_levelSpace`).
steps.lean:
rcases (⟨(·.2.exists_level.elim fun K h ↦ .mono K.mem_nhds_one (Subtype.ext ∘ funext ∘ h ·))⟩ :
    IsSmoothRep ((gridSpace ..).formRep (D.gridKernel false 0 0 false))),
    (gridSpace ..).finite_levelSpace he.1 ⟨D.chosenLevel, isOpen_levelOf⟩

steps.claim: Let A be the sesquilinear map (φ, y) ↦ conj of diagonalPeriodForm(1, 0 ≤ m, g)(conj y, φ) and r(φ) the adjoint of A(φ) restricted to the forms of level chosenLevel, evaluated at 1; it remains, for φ, ϑ and y of level ϑ (m), that ⟨y, rφ⟩ equals the period: write y through its average over chosenLevel (`compactMean`) and use that both sides are constant along the averaging (`map_compactMean_of_const`) and the adjointness.
steps.lean:
refine let A :=
      (diagonalPeriodForm 1 zero_le g ∘ₛₗ conjForm he.2).flip.compr₂ₛₗ (starLinearEquiv ℂ).1
    let r := .applyₗ 1 ∘ₗ .adjoint.1 ∘ₛₗ A.domRestrict₁₂ ..
    ⟨r, fun φ ϑ y m ↦ star_injective ((map_compactMean_of_const (innerₛₗ _ (r φ).1) fun u c ↦
    ?_).symm.trans
      ((((A φ).domRestrict _).adjoint_inner_left ⟨_, compactMean_mem_levelSpace y⟩ _).trans ?_))⟩

steps.claim: The inner product with r(φ), which has level chosenLevel, is invariant under the translations by chosenLevel (`Space.inner_formRep`).
steps.lean: simpa [(r φ).2 ⟨u, c⟩] using! inner_formRep u (r φ) y

steps.claim: The period side is constant along the averaging: for u ∈ chosenLevel it is unchanged when y is translated by u.
steps.lean: simp [-diagonalPeriodForm]; apply map_compactMean_of_const; rintro _ ⟨u, c, rfl⟩

steps.claim: Choose v supported at the places of the modulus, reducing to the inverse of the reduction of u modulo gridModulus(1) (`exists_reductionK₀_eq`).
Then u·v reduces to 1 modulo π̄^{b₁}, i.e. lies in the principal level of gridLevelGen (`Modulus.mem_principalLevel_iff`, `Data.gridModulus_one_ideal`).
Translate both forms by u·v (`Data.diagonalPeriodForm_formRep`): φ is fixed by u·v (its level).

The translate of y by v equals y: v lies in chosenLevel and is trivial off Q, so in the level of y (`Data.chosenLevel_inf_trivialOn_le`, the places of the modulus being the chosen places and Q, `Data.places_modulus_eq_union`).
steps.lean:
simp [A, periodPairing, ← mem_levelSpace_formRep_iff.1 m v (D.chosenLevel_inf_trivialOn_le ϑ
    ⟨(D.chosenLevel.mul_mem_cancel_left ⟨u, c, rfl⟩).1 (principalLevel_le_chosenLevel
    piGBar_dvd_gridLevelGen w), by simp_all [places_modulus_eq_union, IsChosen,
    Gf.mem_supportedOn.1 b, twist_one_spec, levelNorm_mem_and_notMem_of_mem_Q _ ϑ.1.1]⟩) (_ * u.1)]

steps.claim: The remaining membership: the reindexed principal level contains the block (u·v, 1).
steps.lean: simp_all [principalLevel, mem_Kf, reindex_equiv (D.gridDiagEquiv 0)]; exact ⟨0, by simp⟩
